close_reason: Fixed in commit 4a1159d. Replaced backtick intra-doc links to crate-private get_session/post_jmap with plain identifier names in the router fn doc. RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-testjig --no-deps now clean. Workspace fmt/clippy/test stay green.
description:
Pre-existing rustdoc breakage in crate-jmap-testjig/src/http.rs:

```
error: public documentation for `router` links to private item `get_session`
   --> crate-jmap-testjig/src/http.rs:158:35
error: public documentation for `router` links to private item `post_jmap`
   --> crate-jmap-testjig/src/http.rs:159:24
```

The pub fn `router` doc comment uses [`get_session`] and [`post_jmap`] intra-doc links, but both functions are crate-private (`async fn`, not `pub async fn`). RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-testjig --no-deps fails as a result.

The workspace pre-commit gate (per workspace AGENTS.md) is fmt + clippy + test, not doc, so this slipped through. The bug pre-dates bd:JMAP-cf7p.4 (verified by git stash + cargo doc on main).

Fix is trivial — rewrite the doc to use plain identifiers without backtick links:
```rust
/// - `GET /.well-known/jmap` → get_session
/// - `POST /jmap` → post_jmap
```

(or make both pub fn — but they don't need to be on the testjig's public surface.)

Acceptance:
- RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-testjig --no-deps succeeds.
- The doc still names the two handler functions in a useful way (don't just delete the references).
- Workspace fmt + clippy + test stay clean.
title: testjig http.rs: router rustdoc links to private get_session/post_jmap
